text: I run a private company with about 200 staff. Is there a quota that says I must hire a certain number of disabled workers?
note: Act cl.29: 'All employers of labour in public organisations shall, as much as possible, have persons with disabilities constituting at least 5% of their employment.' Factsheet row 'Section 28 / Equal Right to Work' tail: 'Employers of labour in public institutions shall have at least 5% of persons with disabilities in their employment- section' -- carried by ref 'Section 28' (the factsheet has no Section 29 ref). The correct answer is that the 5% duty is on PUBLIC organisations, so a private firm is not bound by it. Mismatch: 'private company', 'quota', 'hire'; corpus: 'employers of labour in public organisations', '5% of their employment'. NOT expected: Act cl.38(d) (Commission to 'make available not less than 5% of the work force') -- a Commission function, not an employer duty; cl.28 -- the equal right to work, not the quota.

text: My mother is a High Court judge and she has become partly blind. Can she be removed from office because of that, and does the disability law protect her right to keep working?

NOT expected: s.291 (judicial pensions) -- not asked; Act cl.1 -- the general prohibition, while cl.28 is the work-specific right the second half asks about.

text: Can I be refused a passport or stopped from leaving Nigeria because I am in a wheelchair?
